svg.text: LESSON GUIDE: DUAL-ROW BRIDGING & DOUBLES PLUS ONE
SERIES 1 • CARD 11 OF 12 • DOMAIN: 5-AND-10 GROUPING & DUAL-ROW ARITHMETIC

text.tspan: When you slide 7 beads on top
and 6 on bottom, how many red
beads are on the left side

g.text: STEP 1: SLIDE 7 BEADS ON TOP ROW
Push all beads to the right side of the
Slide 7 beads to the left on the top rod
All 5 red beads + 2 white beads = 7 beads!
STEP 2: SLIDE 6 BEADS ON BOTTOM ROW
Slide 6 beads to the left on the bottom
All 5 red beads + 1 white bead = 6 beads!
We want to find 7 + 6 without counting
3. GROUP RED BEADS: Look at the red beads on the left: 5 + 5 = 10 (Instant Ten)!
4. ADD WHITE BEADS: Look at the white beads: 2 + 1 = 3 units.
Calculator Verification: Press Number Rack Subitizing Icon ([▦]) and run [7] [ENTER] [6]
CORE PRINCIPLE: DOUBLES MAKE MENTAL MATH EFFORTLESS
Instead of counting 6 fingers past 7, the Rekenrek decomposes 7 + 6 into (5 + 2) + (5 + 1).
The two groups of 5 red beads instantly make 10, leaving 3 white beads. Addition becomes
instantaneous visual pattern recognition rather than tedious memorization!
Slide 8 beads on top (5 red + 3 white) and 7 on bottom (5 red + 2 white). Group the 10 red
beads first! What is the sum? (Scan QR for 3D animated solution!)
→ Assemble with physical blocks, then scan QR code for 3D animated solution.
